text_block_list.text:
I suppose I shouldn't forget that you're
an adult,
Trainer—no matter how cute
you are.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Sorry! It's just that you appeared in my
dream last
night as a little child.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: You were chasing after me, yelling "Mamaaa!" Sigh... It was adorable.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling great today since I got to
spoil you a
whole lot! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'm at a loss for words... but glad she
seems well
rested.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
